name: Timeline Shorts Builder
summary: Create an editable vertical Draft with uncropped native-size media above an optimized, export-safe Selects-style timeline.

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel support, generated-media authoring, and the host FileSystem, SequenceRepository, and SequenceEdit adapters. Worker and OffscreenCanvas support are optional; the panel falls back to sequential UI-thread image conversion. Released-version and Linux compatibility are unverified. Windows x64 runs the same code (host FileSystem, no shell commands) but has not been run on a Windows PC yet.
